provenance.demucs: Demucs 4.1.0 (Défossez et al., MIT) — the vocals stem of the two-stem separation
provenance.method: share = rms(stem)/rms(mix) on 23 ms frames, box 100 ms; pyin 65-1050 Hz, 2048-sample frames; windows: share >= knee = max(0.08, p10 + 0.30*(p95 - p10)) over music frames (mix within 40 dB of p95) for >= 1.0 s, gaps < 0.5 s bridged
provenance.jamendo: "This is a public corpus of 93 creative-commons licensed music pieces annotated by voice (sung or spoken) and no-voice." (jamendo/README; Zenodo record 2585988 license: cc-by-4.0; Ramona, Richard, David, "Vocal detection in music with support vector machines", ICASSP 2008, doi 10.1109/ICASSP.2008.4518002)
